systems.tiers: Expansion financed by a US$70 million concessional loan from Korea's EDCF (committed 2021, signed October 2022, running 2022 to 2028), digitising the population registry and national ID enrolment toward an 88% registration target

note: A finance record for a loan to expand the resident registration and national ID system; it describes identity enrolment and states nothing about the registration of births or deaths.
